Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: Candidate Evan Cho — availability + baseline ask

Hi team,

Quick intro — Evan Cho (SWE backend, strong infra experience) is available for a 4-hour virtual final loop on these windows next week (reported by Talya):
- Tue 2026-12-14: 09:00–13:00 PT
- Wed 2026-12-15: 11:00–15:00 PT

Talya attached an updated resume and said Evan prefers morning PT if possible.

Requested from interview ops: we want a 4-interview structure with short breaks (no more than 10–15 min between interviews) and one 20-minute break mid-loop. Also flagged that Evan has a slight hearing sensitivity — prefer short, spoken instructions and avoid overlapping audio.

Attachments: EvanCho_resume.pdf (from Talya)

Can you each confirm if you can take one of the technical panels and whether you prefer the earlier or later window? If we can lock interviewer assignments by EOD Friday (Dec 4) that gives TA time to send the invite and packet.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Technical Recruiter

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate Evan Cho — availability + baseline ask

Thanks Aditya — looping in the hiring panel leads.

Proposed structure (keeps cognitive load steady and gives two independent graders per competency):
1) System design (60 min) — backend systems, scaling, data flows
2) Deep dive / code review (45 min) — focused on a recent infra change; bring a short PR fragment or pseudo-code
3) Behavioral + problem solving (35 min) — leadership, tradeoffs, cross-team collaboration
4) Ops/observability + product fit (40 min) — alerts, SLOs, runbook thinking

Timing: 60 + 45 + 35 + 40 = 180 min + 20 min break + buffers between interviews (10 min each) => ~4 hours.

Sequencing note: I prefer SD first while the candidate is freshest. Monica — can you take Ops/observability? Laura — can you do the code deep dive? Lauren — can you own the debrief and be the tiebreak lead?

If everyone confirms, I'll draft the calendar invite with staggered panel joins (we'll have the second interviewer join 5 minutes into the session to reduce overlap).

Cheers,
Grace
Principal Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
